marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southwest 15 knots early this evening
except southwest 25 near the Blow River tonight. Wind becoming northwest 20
Saturday morning then backing to west 15 Saturday evening. Scattered showers. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 2 Saturday afternoon then
subsiding to 1 Saturday evening.<br/>
